description: The first call for any piece of work: a page, ad, email, copy, audit, analysis, plan or code. Returns a short brief to act on, up to 4 questions to ask (each with a default) and whether one lead or a team fits. Also an annex to save: what to capture from the client’s real site or data, the rubric and gates, and the AI defaults to avoid. No model calls.
